name: Skip the matrix for identity primitive bounds

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

hypothesisMarkdown: Primitive::bounds runs every primitive's bounds through the transformation matrix (four corner applications and min/max) although nearly every matrix is the unit, and the profile of hover-grid and others put 154 aggregate samples under Primitive::bounds.
measurementPlanMarkdown: Return the corners unchanged when the matrix is the unit. Test the result equals the corner-by-corner transform for several boxes (including negative sizes) and that a translation still goes through the matrix. Alternate previous and new binaries four times on hover-grid, dashboard-all-panels and scroll-div-cards.

measurements.delta: +1% (one old run low; the others equal)

reportMarkdown: A very small gain, consistent in sign on hover-grid and div-cards, nil on dashboard-all-panels. The test and clippy pass.
decisionMarkdown: Keep (minor): bit-identical results for the unit matrix, no cost.
